description: Price history for one livestock category in one region, from the same USDA MARS reports behind get_livestock_price (daily direct-trade reports plus weekly auction summaries). Use for trends; use get_livestock_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns up to `periods` most recent report rows, oldest first; `periods` counts report rows, not calendar days (default 30, max 365).

geography.description: Region or state code (e.g. IA, ECB, KS). Default: IA

periods.description: Number of most recent report rows to return (default 30, max 365)

name: get_livestock_history
